Each pair of distinct circles can intersect in at most 2 points. With 4 circles there are C(4,2) = 6 pairs, so the maximum is 6 × 2 = 12 points.

This is achievable: four circles can be arranged so that every pair crosses in 2 points and no three circles share a common point, for example four circles of equal radius with centers placed close together in general position. Then all 12 intersection points are distinct.

ANSWER: 12
